description: Create or delete a VPS firewall IP set, or add/remove an address (cidr). Rules reference a set as +name. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

cidr.description: add_entry/remove_entry: IP address or CIDR, e.g. 203.0.113.7 or 198.51.100.0/24.

name.description: IP set name (letters, digits, - and _). Use it in rules as +name.

serviceId.description: ID of the VPS: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_vservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: mutate_vserver_firewall_ipset
title: Change VPS Firewall IP Set
